title: Video gets a place in chat
summary:
Video generation joined community chat, Enter explained its tiers more clearly, and app submissions got a new review path.

The community chat app added video generation through `/video` or the attachment menu, with model selection and playback in the conversation. A first-visit tutorial now walks through chat, image and video generation. On the API side, Seedance image-to-video requests now select the image-to-video model, and video duration is passed through as a number.

The TierPanel now explains the Spore-to-Nectar progression, daily Pollen amounts and tier requirements. The model table also marks Gemini Search and Perplexity models with a web-search icon, making that capability easier to spot.

A new showcase submission form makes project language and Discord contact optional. An AI-assisted workflow reviews submissions, asks for more information when needed and can prepare a showcase PR.

highlights.title: Make videos in chat
highlights.text: Use `/video` or the attachment menu to choose a video model, generate a clip and play it in the conversation. A first-visit tutorial covers the basics if you want a map before wandering in.

highlights.title: Submit an app for review
highlights.text: Submit a project to the app showcase with the new form. Project language and Discord contact are optional, and the review can request more information or prepare a showcase PR.
